package.name: z1_ros2_control
package.description:
ros2_control SystemInterface for a real Unitree Z1 arm driven by the official z1_controller. The hardware component is a UDP client of the z1_ctrl process on loopback, speaking the same 147-byte SendCmd / 208-byte RecvState protocol as the official z1_sdk, so z1_ctrl keeps owning the 250 Hz servo loop, the FSM, the kinematics and the collision guard.
It also serves that FSM as `~/set_fsm_state` and `~/get_fsm_state`, which is why this package generates interfaces as well as a plugin.
